text: Leaning with both arms. <break time="0.8s" /> Over the low roof of the boats cabin. <break time="0.8s" /> The white man said to the steersman. <break time="0.8s" /> We will spend the night. <break time="0.8s" /> In Arsats clearing. <break time="0.8s" /> For it is late. <break time="0.8s" /> The steersman only grunted in reply. <break time="0.8s" /> And the boat moved on up a broad river. <break time="0.8s" /> Whose surface shone like metal. <break time="0.8s" /> Under the afternoon sun. <break time="0.8s" /> While the forests on both banks. <break time="0.8s" /> Stood motionless. <break time="0.8s" /> Suddenly the steersman swung the boat. <break time="0.8s" /> At a right angle. <break time="0.8s" /> And drove it through a gap in the bank. <break time="0.8s" /> Into a narrow creek. <break time="0.8s" /> Dark and deep like a ditch. <break time="0.8s" /> Immense trees rose on both sides. <break time="0.8s" /> Their roots twisting. <break time="0.8s" /> Out of the black water. <break time="0.8s" /> And the voices of the paddlers. <break time="0.8s" /> Echoed strangely. <break time="0.8s" /> In the gloom beneath the leaves. <break time="0.8s" /> At last the creek opened. <break time="0.8s" /> Into a wide lagoon. <break time="0.8s" /> So still and dark. <break time="0.8s" /> That the forest and the evening sky. <break time="0.8s" /> Lay reflected on its surface. <break time="0.8s" /> As in a mirror. <break time="0.8s" /> Far across the water. <break time="0.8s" /> Stood a small house. <break time="0.8s" /> Built on high posts. <break time="0.8s" /> Over whose roof. <break time="0.8s" /> Two slender palm trees leaned. <break time="0.8s" /> And the steersman pointed out. <break time="0.8s" /> Arsats canoe tied beneath it. <break time="0.8s" /> The boatmen would have preferred. <break time="0.8s" /> To sleep anywhere else. <break time="0.8s" /> For they did not like Arsat. <break time="0.8s" /> Who was a stranger to their country. <break time="0.8s" /> And lived where no one else dared to live. <break time="0.8s" /> It was said. <break time="0.8s" /> That a man who repairs a ruined house and dwells in it. <break time="0.8s" /> Shows that he is not afraid. <break time="0.8s" /> To live among the spirits that haunt abandoned places.
